name: The court’s new voice

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: Reports from Redridge and the Burning Steppes carry the search into Stormwind. In the Keep, Bolvar Fordragon bears the kingdom’s regency while Countess Katrana Prestor speaks with unusual influence. To the investigators, the mystery is no longer only a nest of dragonkin: a trusted figure sits within the very hall they are trying to protect. The resemblance between rumor and conspiracy remains a question still to be proved.
